title: Corner truncation: up to 20 m2 added to the adjoining lot for the average site area
text: Calculation of minimum site area. C4.1.2 The following adjustments shall apply for the purposes of assessing compliance of a proposed development with the average site areas of Table 4B: i. in the case of a lot with a corner truncation to a public street, up to a maximum of 20m2 of that truncation shall be added to the area of the adjoining lot, survey-strata lot or strata lot as the case may be (refer Figure 4.1a).

replaces.note: C1.1.3(i) only; C1.1.2 and C1.1.3(ii)-(iv) not carried

notes: from: ch3 C4.1.3. diverges: only limb (i), the corner truncation, is carried (p49); the battleaxe and adjoining reserve adjustments and the grouped dwelling site calculation (ch3 C4.1.2) have no equivalent. Calculation rule, not a test: built into C4.1.1 as min(subdivision.truncation_area_added_m2, 20) added to the site area. Heading says 'Calculation of minimum site area' but the text addresses average site area; Figure 4.1a still shows an R30 single-house minimum lot (255.5 m2 + 4.5 m2 = 260 m2) and cites 'C1.1.3i'.

verified.note: Heading reads 'Calculation of minimum site area' though the clause addresses average site area; Figure 4.1a cites 'C1.1.3i'.
